name: ActivateCellInExcelWorksheet
label: Activate Cell in Excel Worksheet
description: Activates a specific cell in the given worksheet based on absolute position, relative offset, or named range.

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The specific worksheet where the cell should be activated. If not provided, the active worksheet will be used.

fields.name: ActivationMode
fields.label: Activation Mode
fields.description: Choose how to activate the cell: absolutely, relatively, or via named range.

selectOptions.label: Activate by Name
selectOptions.description: Activate a cell using its exact row and column coordinates.

selectOptions.label: Activate by Offset
selectOptions.description: Activate a cell relative to the currently active cell by moving a certain number of rows/columns.

selectOptions.label: Activate by Named Range
selectOptions.description: Activate a cell or range by its defined name.

fields.name: Column
fields.label: Column
fields.description: The column letter (e.g., 'A', 'B') or number (e.g., 1, 2) of the target cell.

fields.name: Row
fields.label: Row
fields.description: The row number of the target cell.

fields.name: Name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: The name of the named range or cell to activate.

fields.name: Direction
fields.label: Direction
fields.description: The direction to move from the currently active cell when activating relatively.

selectOptions.label: Up
selectOptions.description: Moves upward from the current cell.

selectOptions.label: Down
selectOptions.description: Moves downward from the current cell.

selectOptions.label: Left
selectOptions.description: Moves left from the current cell.

selectOptions.label: Right
selectOptions.description: Moves right from the current cell.

fields.name: OffsetFromActiveCell
fields.label: Offset From Active Cell
fields.description: Number of cells to move from the current active cell when activating relatively.
